_tag_definitions.cost-eats-edge: Cost ratio (friction / gross) > 50% OR cost-adjusted PF < 1.10 with healthy gross PF
_tag_definitions.concentration: Any of: top-3 > 30%, top-10 > 55%, max-year > 40% (workhorse) / 50% (tail-engine), top-3-trade > 25%
_tag_definitions.regime-dependent: Walk-forward H1 vs H2 PF asymmetry > 1.5× OR PF carried by ≤2 calendar years
_tag_definitions.WF-split-fail: H1 PF < 1.0 OR H2 PF < 1.0 OR median sign flips between halves
_tag_definitions.median-negative: Median trade ≤ 0 — fails edge doctrine signal #1 (positive median)
_tag_definitions.insufficient-n: n < 50 for any archetype OR n < 500 forced through workhorse routing
_tag_definitions.duplicate/overlap: Same (asset × entry × filter) family already represented in core/probation; adding this would concentrate, not diversify
_tag_definitions.data-blocked: Requires data source not in current tree (e.g. EIA stock changes, OPEC outcomes, FRED rate series, auction calendar, intraday curve)
_tag_definitions.implementation-blocked: Requires primitive not in ENTRY_MAP / EXIT_MAP / FILTER_MAP / harness (e.g. event-window candidate, monthly rebalance, stateful entry filter)
